UniversalSearchProjection.description: Universal result projection surface shared by ASP search/query endpoints.

description:
Universal ASP Search & Query Protocol Contract (`universal-search-protocol.schema.json`).

Single language-neutral Draft 2020-12 protocol schema forwarded by ASP `GET /v1/providers`
(`universalProtocolSchema`). External language providers (`asp-rust`, `asp-python`,
`asp-typescript`, `AspJulia.jl`, `asp-gerbil-scheme`, ...) extend this base contract via
[`ProviderSpecialExtension`] over HTTP/gRPC without modifying ASP or Marlin core.

context.description: Source context lines shown around each match.

exclude-path-prefix.description: Workspace-relative path prefix excluded from results.

exclude-tests?.description: Exclude test files and test modules from results.

ext.description: Source file extension filter without leading dot (projected from provider manifests).

kind.description: Universal General Ontology symbol kind filter (refined per language by `special`).

lang.description: Canonical language identifier served by an ASP provider (or `"any"`).

languageKind.description: Native compiler AST node kind (populated dynamically from each provider's `special` schema).

max-per-file.description: Maximum symbols emitted per file in multi-file `file-outline`.

min-files.description: Minimum distinct files sharing a symbol name in `find-collisions` (2..4).

module-limit.description: Maximum scoped modules passed into finite-choice `solve-placement`.

name-contains.description: Case-insensitive substring or token list matched against symbol names.

path-prefix.description: Workspace-relative directory or file path prefix scoping the query.

special.description: Optional language-specific `special` extension filters validated against the active provider's schema.

state-budget.description: Bounded Dusa finite-choice exploration state budget.

symbol.description: Exact symbol anchor name for zero-I/O file reads or impact analysis.

title: ASP Universal Search Protocol
